title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E17 — Most Notorious - Ariel Castro
In a story that gripped the nation, three Cleveland women are rescued ten years after vanishing from the city's streets; authorities must confront the man at heart of this notorious crime to unravel the sinister details surrounding the abductions.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E18 — Honey, Are You in There?
After police respond to an apparent suicide, the case takes an unexpected turn when investigators cannot find a gun near the body.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E19 — Killer Charm
Local police and the FBI join forces to track down a suspected serial killer after the disappearance of an 80-year-old woman.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E20 — First Comes Marriage Then Comes Murder
When a young woman vanishes, detectives zero in on her controlling estranged husband - whose story continually changes in the interrogation room.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E21 — Gone Girl
A mother from Florida vanishes into the night after celebrating her daughter's first birthday; in their search to find her, the police seek answers from the father of her child.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E10 — Alejandro Corredor
Alejandro Corredor is Kansas City's cocaine pipeline, moving massive shipments from Mexico's Sinaloa Cartel.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E14 — Bird & The New Breed: Dana Bostic
Bostic's New Breeds would package and distribute heroin and defend their turf with violence.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E12 — Los Muchachos: Augusto Falcon and Salvador Magluta
A pair of powerboat racers who allegedly moved more illegal narcotics than just about anyone in the history of the U.S. War on Drugs.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E09 — Mother of the Avenues: Maria "Chata" Leon
Maria Leon commanded a reign of terror in L.A.; the criminal underworld created by her murderous brood of children.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E05 — Philly's Gangster Queen: Thelma Wright
With a taste of success and the lure of easy money, Thelma started transporting cocaine and heroin between Los Angeles and Philadelphia.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E15 — Quasand Lewis
Quasand Lewis made millions by way of drug trafficking; the federal government launched "Operation Falling Star" in order to take down 'Q' and build the largest drug-related prosecution in the history of the state of Michigan.

title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
description:
S02 E11 — Sex, Money, Murder, Inc.: "Pistol Pete" Rollack
Pistol Pete and his underlings incorporated the gang Sex, Money, Murder in an effort to launder drug money and expanded their operations outside New York.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E04 — Boiling Points
The security team is on high alert during scorching temperatures in Cleveland and fans tailgating in the heat hours before kickoff; from medical emergencies to a vaping ejection that escalates, the teams face challenges at every turn.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E05 — Frost & Furious
Highly trained law enforcement officers, private security teams and medics protect this stadium; a winter storm descends on the stadium, covering it in snow, which intensifies the night.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E06 — Battle of Ohio
Tensions rise as officers respond to urgent calls including preventing intoxicated individuals from entering the stadium; tracking down a wanted man in the stadium; enforcing the zero tolerance smoking policy; reviewing CCTV footage.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E07 — Zero Tolerance
Protecting the stadium are highly trained men and women from law enforcement, private security teams and medics; in this episode, the security team escorts defiant smokers from the stadium while on high alert.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E08 — Lost and Loaded
The security team handles a range of incidents, from ejecting fans for vaping and breaking up a large scuffle in the stands, to investigating the disappearance of a young man whose worried parents and girlfriend report him missing.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E09 — Out With a Bang!
In this episode, the security team helps a family deal with a loved one who is in a precarious emotional state; they eject some very hostile fans and reunite a lost little boy with his parents after his mom suffers a sudden seizure in the concourse.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E10 — Preseason Problems
Protecting the stadium are highly trained men and women from law enforcement, private security teams and medics; new members of the team blend with seasoned veterans as the staff faces multiple challenges.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E16 — Blue Bonnet Bandit
A look at some of the arrests from across the country; a man arrested at sea tries to swim away from police; a man wearing a blue bonnet steals baby formula; a mom goes to extreme measures with a housemate and is arrested for assault.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E17 — Push-Up Rage
A hyped-up man goes toe to toe with police; a woman flips off fellow drivers while dancing in the street; a pilot is arrested for allegedly stealing a plane; and more.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E18 — Naked Chaos
A boater goes off the deep end; a naked man causes traffic chaos; a police uniform-swiper gets taken to the cleaners; and more.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E19 — Mr. Funk's Wild Ride
A man calls 911 on the cops; a woman is accused of stealing a horse and buggy; a man allegedly trespasses and shoots rats in a neighbor's yard.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E20 — Sweet Tea Pleasure
A suspect crashes into a jail; a woman has fun at the movies; a vandal wreaks havoc at a winery.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E21 — Top 5: Intoxicating Moments
A look at some strange moments of intoxicated arrestees from across the country; a man is arrested for drunk driving a lawnmower; a friend joins her bestie in jail after a DUI.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E22 — Top 5: Bare Naked Moments
A naked woman is arrested for stealing a sheriff's pickup truck; a gym goer loses his cool and his clothing; and a golf pro spectator streaks into the spotlight.

description:

title: Elizabeth Smart: Finding Justice
description:
S01 E01 — The Brainwashed Bride: The Candra Torres Case
Chandra Torres sits down with fellow kidnapping victim Elizabeth Smart to discuss life in captivity at the hands of a master manipulator and murderer.

title: Elizabeth Smart: Autobiography
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
Kidnapping victim Elizabeth Smart, family members and law-enforcement officials discuss the 2002 abduction that made national headlines and the efforts made to find and save her.

title: Elizabeth Smart: Autobiography
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
Kidnapping victim Elizabeth Smart tells the story of traveling to Southern California with her abductors, their return to Utah, and how the television show "America's Most Wanted" played a role in her rescue.

title: Jodi Arias: Cellmate Secrets
description: New information comes to light about Jodi Arias and the murder of her ex-boyfriend, Travis Alexander, as her former cellmates and closest confidants give firsthand accounts of their time behind bars with the murderess.

title: Jonestown: The Women Behind the Massacre
description: Four women belonging to cult leader Jim Jones' inner circle help plan the 1978 Jonestown massacre in Guyana, which leaves more than 900 people dead.
